question: Should OpenClaw accept this CLI catalog as a core public CLI/plugin/prompt surface now, split it into narrower staged surfaces, or keep it as an RFC/prototype?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds new user-facing commands, plugin descriptor fields, generated docs, report scripts, and prompt behavior; code review cannot choose that product/API boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split Direction First
options.body: Keep the draft open but ask for a staged plan that separates the stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.

options.title: Accept As Experimental Core Surface
options.body: Maintainership can explicitly sponsor the broad surface and require compatibility docs, live proof, and conflict resolution before landing.

options.title: Pause The Prototype
options.body: If this catalog is not desired in core now, keep discussion in the linked RFC or close the branch until a maintainer sponsors it.

recommendation.title: Split Direction First
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open but ask for a staged plan that separates the stable CLI read path from plugin API and prompt changes before merge.
